website.how: Titled 'Gaylon Kent For Congress'; its inner page says he is the Libertarian Party nominee from Colorado's 2nd Congressional District; linked from the Libertarian Party of Colorado's 2026 candidate list.

Titled 'Joe Neguse for Colorado', speaks of Colorado's 2nd District, calls him Colorado Congressman Joe Neguse and carries 'Paid for by Joe Neguse for Congress'. (joeneguseforcongress.com redirects here.)
Titled 'Douglas Mangeris - Libertarian for Colorado District 4' and headed 'Colorado District 4 - U.S. House'.
Titled 'Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher | Democrat for Congress', speaks of Colorado's 4th District and carries 'Paid for by Eileen for Colorado'.
Titled 'Standing for Freedom | Lauren Boebert' and carries 'Paid for by Lauren Boebert for Congress' with a Colorado committee address; the page does not name the district number.
Titled 'Luis Galvan for Congress CO-4', says he is a candidate for Colorado's 4th Congressional District and explains how to write his name in on the U.S. House District 4 line.
Titled 'Jason Clark for US Congress Colorado District 6' and carries 'Paid for by Jason Clark for US Congress'.
Carries 'Paid for by Jason Crow for Congress' with a Colorado committee address and speaks of Coloradans; the page does not name the district number. (jasoncrowforcongress.com redirects here.)
Titled 'Patty McMahon for Congress | Colorado's 6th District' and says she is the Libertarian nominee for Colorado's 6th Congressional District.
Titled 'Dr. Witta for Congress | Colorado's 6th District' and describes him as 'Independent Candidate, Colorado's 6th District'.
Titled 'Dave Wood for Congress', says he is running to represent Colorado Congressional District 8 on Libertarian principles; linked from the Libertarian Party of Colorado's 2026 candidate list.
Titled 'Elect Gabe Evans', calls him Congressman Gabe Evans who represents Colorado's 8th Congressional District.
Titled 'Manny for Colorado | Manny Rutinel for Congress', says he is running for Congress in Colorado's 8th District and carries 'Paid for by Manny Rutinel for Congress'.
